about: Shared cases for round 40, written by the browser simulation. The Windows app must give the same answers.

said.sends: Only when you press Test or Send in MCP tools: the start of a session and a request for its list of tools; when you press Send, the tool's name and the arguments shown to you first. Nothing by itself.
said.kept: This tool keeps nothing of what is sent or answered: the answer is shown, never stored. What the server keeps is set by whoever runs it.
said.hint: An MCP server offers tools that this app can call for you: a search, a lookup, a calculation. A server is reached over https:// (http:// for this PC only), or is a program on this PC that IT approved: added with “Add a program on this PC”, by its full path and the SHA-256 IT gives, which the app checks before each start; the app asks you before it starts the program, and stops it when you are done. Nothing is sent by itself: Test asks a server for its list of tools, and MCP tools (in the tray menu's More) shows you exactly what a call sends before you press Send. The token stays in the environment variable you name and is never saved by the app. A server's answer and its descriptions of its tools are shown as plain text and are never followed as instructions.
said.noServer: No MCP server is switched on. Add one in Settings, AI and connections.
said.notJson: The arguments must be one JSON object, for example {"query": "text"}.
said.tooLong: The arguments are longer than 20,000 characters.
